CoworkOS ’s room card combines 14.9 m 2 , dimensions of 4.68 × \times 3.18 m, and the retained 17:00 time, 1.40 m section, and material scheme B. The comparison concerns how object information and current settings are presented; retaining settings is shared by the three implementations.
blocks.zh: 图9 a比较了厨房在法院院的检查情况。 审查员在选择房间前会先调整区段高度,时间和材料;这三项执行都提供局部检查,并在返回时保留设置. Codex将眼平面的庭院取景与部分,时间,和材料控制相配于底部,而无需在房间描述中列出面积或尺寸. DSH标注了10.0米2的面积,并注明了日光,分地和材料保存完好. CoworkOS的房卡结合了14.9米2,尺寸为4.68×正时为3.18米,保留时间为17:00分,面积为1.40米,材料方案为B. 比较涉及对象信息和当前设置的列报方式;保留设置由三个执行部分共享.

blocks.en: Figure 9 b shows feedback in Ridge Pack . After attempts to insert the same eight named items in sequence, Codex reports that the picnic blanket cannot fit and suggests removing a larger item or using the 18 L pack. DSH’s recorded view lists compartment coordinates for packed items, with the blanket remaining unpacked; its transient rejection message was not captured, so the record does not establish whether it explains the cause. CoworkOS ’s displayed message distinguishes spare volume from usable contiguous space: 5.98 L remains, but fragmentation prevents any placement from clearing neighboring items. It also suggests the Optimize action or removal of a bulky neighbor. This supports a more specific rejection explanation than Codex’s visible message. The implementations use different authored item dimensions, so packed-item counts and capacity values are not used to rank packing algorithms.
blocks.zh: 图9b显示Ridge Pack中的反馈。 在试图按顺序插入同8个被命名的物品后,Codex报告说野餐毯不能合用,并建议取出更大的物品或使用18L包. DSH记录的视图列出了被包装物品的隔间坐标,毯子仍然被打包;其瞬间拒绝消息没有被捕获,因此记录无法确定它是否解释了原因. CoworkOS显示的电文区分了备用量与可用毗连空间:5.98 L依然存在,但碎片化使任何放置都无法清理相邻物品。 它还建议优化行动或清除一个庞大的邻居. 这支持比Codex可见消息更具体的拒绝解释. 实施使用不同的被作者项维度,因此打包项计数和容量值不用于对包装算法进行排序.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Frontend website interaction evidence. Columns show Codex, DSH, and CoworkOS . (a) Kitchen inspection with room information. (b) Exploded pack views, followed by feedback from the recorded item-insertion sequence. Each panel pairs a scene view with a native interface crop; English notes below the crops summarize the observations.
blocks.zh: 图9:前端网站互动证据. 列显示 Codex, DSH, 和 CoworkOS 。 (a) 厨房检查和房间资料。 (b) 散开的包式视图,再取录入项序列的反馈。 每个面板对一场景取景,并有本土界面收成;收成下方的英文注释总结了观测结果.

blocks.en: Figure 10 expands the Paper Glider and Fruit Slicer comparisons. The following checks cover inputs and feedback across all three harnesses in four games.
blocks.zh: 图10扩展了纸张粘贴剂和水果粘贴剂的比较。 以下检查涵盖四个游戏中所有三个游戏的输入和反馈.

blocks.en: Bubble Bastion. Codex shows a cross-shaped splash, crate particles, and an increased crate-clearance counter; restarting clears this progress. DSH awards points after a bubble burst near a bush, presents a failure screen, and resets the score and enemy objective on retry. CoworkOS previews the cross-shaped danger area before the burst, repeats the objective in its pause panel, and restores the initial objective and hearts after a splash-related failure and retry.
blocks.zh: 泡泡贝斯通. Codex 显示一个跨形状的喷出物,板条箱颗粒,以及一个增加的板条箱清空计数器;重新开始清除这个进展. DSH奖项在一股气泡在灌木丛附近爆出后分出分数,呈现出一出故障屏幕,再将分数和敌人目标重回重试. CoworkOS在爆裂前预览出跨形状的危险区域,在其暂停面板中重复目标,并在一次与溅射相关的失败后再进行重试后恢复初始目标和心脏.

blocks.en: Paper Glider. All three respond to steering, display ring progress, and provide failure and retry feedback. Codex reports missed target rings, while DSH couples ring passage with point notifications. CoworkOS ’s result dialog explains the missed-ring allowance; retry resets the progress. Figure 10 a shows the scene differences: Codex foregrounds bright rings, windows, and a corridor outline; DSH adds a desk, lamp, rug, and plant. CoworkOS integrates book-filled shelves, curtains, seating, wall panels, ceiling beams, and floor shadows into a furnished study surrounding the flight route.
blocks.zh: 纸张滑翔机。 三者都响应方向盘,显示环行进度,并提供故障并重试反馈. Codex报告错过了目标环,而DSH夫妇则以点通知环绕通过. CoworkOS 的结果对话框解释了丢失的环宽限; 重试重回进度 。 图10 a显示场景差异: Codex前方有明亮的环,窗户,并有走廊轮廓;DSH增加了一个桌子,灯光,地毯和植物. 协作 OS将装有图书的书架,窗帘,座椅,墙面板,天花板梁和地板阴影整合成一个围绕飞行路线的配备齐全的研究.

blocks.en: Racing. Codex and DSH register steering, checkpoint progress, and nitro consumption; restart resets checkpoint and timing displays. DSH also shows the vehicle and checkpoints on a minimap and issues a wrong-way warning. In CoworkOS , throttle and steering change vehicle speed, heading, and distance to the next checkpoint. Pressing T after driving onto the shoulder returns the car to checkpoint 0 with an explicit message while retaining elapsed time; pressing R restarts the run and resets the timer.
blocks.zh: 赛跑. Codex和DSH 注册方向盘,检查站进度,以及硝基消费量;重启重新设置检查站和计时显示. DSH还用迷你地图显示车辆和检查站,并发出错误的警告. 在 CoworkOS 中,节流阀和方向改变车速、行驶方向和距离到下一个检查站。 驾驶到肩部后按下 T , 在保留已过期时间的同时, 将车返回0号检查站, 并带有明确的信息; 按下 R 重新启动运行并重置定时器 。

blocks.en: Fruit Slicer. Pointer drags increase cut counts and scores in all three, with visible fruit separation and juice effects. Codex shows combo and double-slice feedback; DSH increments a missed-fruit counter before presenting failure and retry. CoworkOS combines detailed fruit interiors, blade trails, and particles with bamboo, mountain scenery, and a wooden dojo frame (Figure 10 b). Its HUD reaches the cut target and invites continued scoring; the observed run subsequently ends after excessive misses. Retry resets progress while retaining the best score. Displayed scores and times reflect each game’s own rules and are not used to rank harness success rates.
blocks.zh: 水果斯莱克 指向拖取会增加切分数和分数,在全部三个中都有明显的果分和果汁效果. Codex显示组合和双切片反馈;DSH在显示失败和重试前会递增一个漏出水果计数器. CoworkOS结合了详细的水果内饰,刃道,和颗粒与竹子,山地风景,并配有木制道场框(图10b). 其HUD达到了被切断的目标,请继续打分;被观测到的跑在被过度错过后会结束. 在保留最佳分数的同时重试重排进度 。 显示的分数和时间反映了每个游戏自己的规则,不用于对使用成功率进行排序.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Game scenes and interaction details. Columns show Codex, DSH, and CoworkOS . (a) Interiors and flight routes in Paper Glider . (b) Slicing effects and environments in Fruit Slicer , including a frame from pointer-driven play. Native views are scaled proportionally without retouching.
blocks.zh: 图10:游戏场景和互动细节. 列显示 Codex, DSH, 和 CoworkOS 。 (a) Paper Glider中的内政和飞行路线。 (b) 水果滑冰机的切片效应和环境,包括取自指针驱动的游戏的相框。 土著观点在不调整的情况下按比例缩小。

blocks.en: Figure 11 preserves two sets of native content-page details used in the main comparison. In Mogao Caves (a), the descriptions in Codex’s three metric cards extend below their bottom borders. In DSH’s lower two cards, the suffixes meaning “more than” and “years” wrap below the large numbers and overlap the descriptions. CoworkOS keeps each value, label, and explanation inside its card. The pages use different figures and wording; the comparison concerns text containment and metric grouping, not numerical correctness. In Aral Sea (b), Codex’s upper arrow chain sequentially connects upstream diversion, reduced inflow, evaporation, falling water levels, and ecological degradation. Its full page also separates human activities from natural conditions in two text groups below the chain. DSH organizes the process into three explanatory cards. CoworkOS separates reduced inflow and evaporation into two diagram branches entering a shared outcome. The distinction is whether the two displayed paths are separated directly in the relation diagram, not whether the baselines mention the relevant causes.
blocks.zh: 图11保留了主比较中使用的两套本土内容-页面细节. 在Mogao Caves(a)中,Codex的3个度量卡的描述延伸到了底边。 在DSH的下两张牌中,后缀意为"超过"和"年份",被围在了大数下并重复了描述. 协作 OS将每个值,标签,以及解释都保存在其卡片内. 各页使用不同的数字和措辞;比较涉及文本封装和计量分组,而不是数字正确性。 在咸海(b)中,Codex的上箭链相继连接了上游分流,减少了流入,蒸发,水位下降和生态退化. 其整页还把人类活动与自然条件区分在链条下的两个文本组. DSH将过程组织为三张解释卡. CoworkOS将减少的入流和蒸发分出两个图分支,进入共同的结果. 区别在于显示的两种路径是否在关系图中直接分开,而不是基线是否提到相关原因.

blocks.en: The Codex / DSH / CoworkOS page selections are 2 / 3 / 2 for Mogao metrics and 5 / 3 / 5 for Aral causes. Rectangular crops preserve complete metric groups, the arrow chain, the explanatory-card group, or the branched diagram. The roasting pages in Coffee Journey provide a further comparison: CoworkOS page 6 links numbered photo annotations to descriptions of the roaster and cooling tray; Codex page 8 separates heating, moisture loss, cooling, and resting into four stage cards; DSH page 6 pairs stage descriptions with a time curve. The first emphasizes component-to-text correspondence, while the latter two organize the process. This does not establish broader topic coverage for CoworkOS . These content-page observations do not extend to Butterfly Life Cycle , for which only covers were inspected.
blocks.zh: Codex / DSH / CoworkOS 页面选择是 Mogao 度量衡的 2 / 3 / 2, 和 5 / 3 / 5 的 咸生因. 矩形作物保存完整的公尺组,箭链,解释卡组,或分枝图. 咖啡之旅的烤页提供了进一步的对比: CoworkOS 第6页链接了对烤箱和冷却托盘描述的编号相片说明; 第8页将取暖,水分损失,冷却,休息分为四个相片; DSH 第6页有时间曲线的对相片相片描述. 第一个强调成份对正文的对应,而后两个则组织这一过程. 这并没有为 " CoworkOS " 确定更广泛的专题范围。 这些内容页的观察没有延伸到蝴蝶生命周期,只检查了它的封面。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Office content-page details. Columns show Codex, DeepSeek Harness (DSH), and CoworkOS . (a) Mogao Caves metric groups, from pages 2 / 3 / 2. (b) Aral Sea cause explanations, from pages 5 / 3 / 5. Rectangular crops retain each complete metric group or relation representation; native text and graphics are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图11:办公室内容-网页详情。 栏显示 Codex, DeepSeek Harness (DSH)和 CoworkOS . (a) Mogao Caves 度量组,从 第 2 / 3 / 2. (b) 咸海引起解释,从 第 5 / 3 / 5. 矩形作物保留了每个完整的度量组或关系代表;原生文字和图形不变.

blocks.en: In CREMA Espresso (Figure 12 a), native expansion changes component positions and presents descriptions in all three implementations. CoworkOS moves the camera back, reduces the title, and retracts the long introduction, keeping the separated lid, twin-boiler group, brew head, drip tray, and base within one view alongside six description groups. Codex separates the lid and side panels in different directions and keeps eight descriptions beside the assembly. DSH’s initial expanded view clips the upper shell; native zoom-out brings it into view, but the opaque shell still occludes parts of the boilers. The figure uses this zoomed-out view. This comparison concerns framing and information organization in the expanded state; it does not imply that the baselines lack expansion or component descriptions.
blocks.zh: 在CREMA Espresso(图12a)中,本土扩展部分改变位置,并在所有三个执行部分中作出说明。 CoworkOS将相机向后移动,减少标题,并收回了长长的介绍,将相隔的盖子,双锅管组,酿酒头,滴盘和基部与6个描述组并排在一个视图内. Codex将盖子和侧面板分出不同方向,并保存了8个描述与组装相邻. DSH最初扩展的取景会将上层外壳剪断;原生的缩放会把它带入视野,但不透明的外壳仍然会遮住锅炉的部分. 该图采用了这个缩放视图. 这种比较涉及扩大状态下的框架和信息组织;这并不意味着基线缺乏扩展或构成部分说明。

blocks.en: For CSA2 Attention (b), the reviewer switches from Full to Reindex and then Reuse at the Selection stage. Selected positions change from [ 0 , 3 , 8 ] [0,3,8] to [ 1 , 4 , 7 ] [1,4,7] and persist in Reuse. All three implementations display state changes, provenance colors, and stage explanations. CoworkOS uses front-facing labels to connect positions to yellow Main KV and coral Top-K, with text stating that corresponding entries are copied while the original cache remains. Codex likewise explains copy-forward behavior and cache preservation, and grays out inactive indexing; its in-scene position labels use a smaller oblique arrangement. DSH also explains index reuse, but its low-angle view crowds labels around Main Q, SWA KV, and Selection. These are legibility differences in the selected views, not validations of algorithmic equivalence or user comprehension. The advantage is also case-dependent: repeated reset, expansion, waiting, and rotation did not clearly expose separated internals in CoworkOS ’s VESPER Speaker , and Codex’s Saturn Atlas cutaway distinguished interior layers more clearly.
blocks.zh: 对于CSA2注意(b),审查员从Full切换到Reindex,然后在选择阶段再使用. 所选位置由[0,3,8] [0,3,8]改为[1,4,7] [1,4,7],并坚持再用. 所有三个执行都显示状态变化,出处颜色,以及阶段解释. CoworkOS使用前置标签将位置连接到黄色主KV和珊瑚Top-K上,并有文字说明相应的条目在原缓存保留时被复制. Codex同样解释了复制前向行为和缓存保存,而灰色出非活动索引;其内景位置标签使用更小的斜面安排. DSH也解释了索引再利用,但其低角取景会把标签围绕Main Q,SWA KV,以及Setch. 这些是所选观点中的可辨别性差异,而不是算法等同或用户理解的验证. 其优势也取决于案例:反复重置、扩展、等待和旋转并没有清楚地暴露出CowoOS的VESPER扬声器中分离出的内部,而Codex的土星图集则更清楚地暴露出分离出的内部分层。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Interactive visualization evidence. Columns show Codex, DSH, and CoworkOS . (a) Expanded CREMA Espresso assemblies and component-description crops; DSH uses its native zoom-out control. (b) CSA2 Attention in Reuse mode at Selection, with native explanation crops. English notes summarize the observations; native image content is unchanged.

blocks.en: Figure 13 supplements the main half-sections with assembled details. In Turbofan Engine (a), Codex shows axial blade groups and an annular core within a transparent casing, with relatively little peripheral equipment. DSH’s opaque casing conceals the core at this angle, with annular bands and rods visible outside; the shared half-section in Figure 6 e confirms its detailed multistage blade rows. CoworkOS distributes bent tubes, annular components, and block-like accessories around the core, supporting the main-text observation of richer peripheral assembly detail. In Robotic Joint Module (b), both Codex and CoworkOS have housing ribs and populated flange fasteners; the full assembled CoworkOS view also shows a protruding side connection detail. DSH uses a smoother housing with flange holes and a central opening, while its section still exposes a layered interior. These differences concern the visual representation of peripheral structure and interfaces; casing occlusion is not used to infer missing internals.
blocks.zh: 图13以组装的细节补充了主要半节. 在Turbofan Engine(a)中,Codex显示轴叶片组和透明外壳内的废芯,外围设备相对较少. DSH的不透明外壳在这个角度上隐藏了核心,在外可看到废接带和棒;图6 e中共享的半段证实了其详细的多相叶片行. CoworkOS将弯曲的管子,去除组件,以及像块状的配件围绕核心,支持更丰富的外围组装细节的主文观测. 在"机器人联合模块"(b)中,Codex和CoworkOS都配有内置肋骨和人所居住的法兰克紧接器;完整组装的CoworkOS视图还显示出一个可穿透的侧式连接细节. DSH使用有花纹孔和中央开口的更平滑的外壳,而其部分仍然暴露出一层层的内部. 这些差异涉及外观结构和接口的视觉表现;外壳隐蔽不被用来推断缺失的内部.

blocks.en: All six STEP files were independently imported and transferred with OpenCascade / OCP 8.0.1.1.0 without source modification. Visible axial cavities in section also do not establish a continuous through-bore in the complete assembly. These observations support native readability, inspectability, and comparisons of visible structural detail; they do not establish parametric editability, interference-free fit, tolerances, manufacturability, or operating performance. Orbit, section, and wireframe controls belong to the shared inspection viewer.
blocks.zh: 所有6个STEP文件都是独立导入并随OpenCascade / OCP 8.0.1.1.0一起传输的,没有源代码修改. 节中可见轴腔也并不在整装中建立连续通波. 这些观测结果支持本地的可读性、可检查性以及对可见结构细节的比较;它们没有确定参数编辑性、无干扰相容性、耐受性、可制造性或操作性能。 轨道,路段和线框控制器属于共享检查取景器.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Additional CAD evidence. Columns show Codex, DSH, and CoworkOS . (a) Peripheral regions of assembled turbofan engines. (b) Robotic-joint housing and output interfaces. Each row uses the same inspection view and crop rule after axis alignment. Authored cutaways, transparency, and opaque surfaces are retained. Unretouched crops demonstrate visible structural detail; the shared half-sections in Figure 6 e expose the internals.
blocks.zh: 图13:补充CAD证据。 列显示 Codex, DSH, 和 CoworkOS 。 (a) 组装涡轮风扇发动机的周边区域。 (b) 机器人-联合住房和产出接口。 每行在轴向调整后使用相同的检查视图和收割规则. 保留了授权剪接、透明度和不透明的表面。 未取回的作物显示出明显的结构细节;图6 e中共享的半段暴露出内部.

blocks.en: The main Qianqing Palace views use corresponding principal-hall roof and terrace bounds; Figure 14 a adds facades inspected through native orbit and zoom. Codex retains layered roofs, ridge ornaments, window divisions, a raised platform, and balustrades, with visible blue–green eave bands, although broad roof and wall surfaces appear pale. DSH clearly differentiates tile rows, painted eaves, and red door and window panels; its main facade has a less prominent projecting colonnade, and its side halls use simpler long roof and wall masses. CoworkOS separates golden roofs, red columns, lattice panels, painted eaves, and pale stonework into distinguishable components. The front colonnade, steps, and axial approach remain identifiable after changing viewpoint. These observations concern delivered materials and architectural legibility, not historical accuracy; mesh counts are not treated as quality scores.

DSH明确区分了瓦片的行,被漆的活字,和红色的门和窗面板;它的主外观有不太突出的投影结肠道,它的侧厅使用更简单的长屋顶和墙质. CoworkOS将金色的屋顶,红色的柱子,花纹面板,彩绘的活纹,和苍白的石活化为可分辨的部件. 在改变观点后,前面的结肠、步骤和轴线方法仍然可以识别。 这些观察涉及交付的材料和建筑的可辨别性,而不是历史的准确性;网目计数不被视为质量分数。

blocks.en: In the main After the Fall view, CoworkOS connects foreground vehicles, a mid-street bus, damaged multi-storey buildings, and distant shells into a continuous street. Cables span the road, and an emissive hotel sign anchors the right facade. Codex also has pronounced depth: its NO FUTURE and SECTOR 7 signs, dense rubble, and street equipment form a more crowded urban corridor. DSH combines a rusty vehicle, low-rise ruins, a bent street light, and an illuminated shelter in a more open setting. These differences concern spatial organization and asset composition, without establishing that CoworkOS leads on every scene detail. Alternate-view crops (b) retain vehicle and street details, including the visible gap between CoworkOS ’s bus wheels or lower body and the road. Spatial depth does not establish correct prop support or collision. Views retain delivered materials and presentation settings rather than calibrated shared lighting. The evaluation uses GLB exports, which contain no animation tracks; viewpoint motion does not establish model animation.
